Bug_Title: BAC: Bad Applet Constructor relies on uninitialized AppletStub (BAC_BAD_APPLET_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Details:
This constructor calls methods in the parent Applet that rely on the AppletStub. Since the AppletStub
isn't initialized until the init() method of this applet is called, these methods will not perform
correctly.
Bug_Explanation: The constructor of the BadAppletConstructorExample class attempts to call getParameter to retrieve an applet parameter before the AppletStub is initialized. This results in incorrect behavior as the AppletStub is not set up until the init() method is called.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case instantiates the BadAppletConstructorExample and calls the showBug method to demonstrate the behavior before the AppletStub is ready. This should trigger a NullPointerException or incorrect behavior since the getParameter method is called before the AppletStub is initialized.
